name: Float
doc: Float (spell): one target task per action, in turn (one every 10 ticks), each two prim-model layouts in a frame of the action's target (turned with it, scaled by its size): the lift glyph at its feet, from tick 12 a second layout at its effect point 0xF0; the target takes the result at tick 64.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values): where it is in FF8_EN.exe and its size. A new effect copies it into its program ("data").

depth_point.doc: the point (x, y, z, pad) of the upper layout's frame whose depth it takes

magic_buffer.doc: Offsets in the magic buffer: the two packet arenas the director alternates, the layouts' blended vertex frames (after the three target nodes).

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The root starts one target task per action, in turn; each target task's clock: its sound, its result, its end; both layouts' size (draws nothing)

parts.title: Glyph
parts.doc: The lift glyph at the target's feet, turned with it

parts.title: Upper layout
parts.doc: The second layout at one of the target's effect points, turned with it, its depth from a point of it

groups.label: Size
groups.doc: Both layouts scaled by ((the target's size >> 1) + Base) >> Shift (4096 = their own size)

params.label: Every
params.doc: The root starts the next action's target task every this many ticks

params.label: Sound
params.doc: The sound block played (its world sound id: an audio.dat entry)

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound plays at the target's effect position when the target tick == this

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The action's target takes the result when the target tick == this

params.label: End tick
params.doc: The target task ends when its tick reaches this

params.label: Bone
params.doc: The target's effect point giving its x and z (0xF0 and up: the engine's named points)

params.label: Bone
params.doc: The target's effect point it is at

tasks.doc: One per action: two layouts in frames of the action's target, turned with it (record flag 0x8000: an object not turned with the frame), scaled by its size; the sound at its first tick at the target's effect position; the result; the end.
